newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek shares end down on poll interpretation.
newsitem.headline: Greek shares end down on poll interpretation.

text.p: Greek equities came off session lows to close 0.63 percent lower and market watchers said the bourse read into Sunday's polls a rising likelihood of no strong government emerging from the ballots on September 22.

"The market interpreted the results of Sunday's poll as an increase in the likelihood that no strong government will emerge on September 22 and the general index fell," said Costas Panagidis, general director at Axon Securities SA.
But the electoral law favours the lead party even if it wins on a small margin and I have no doubt that a strong government will emerge on election day, said Panagidis.
"It does not really matter which party is going to come out first from the ballot," he said. "Both major parties have made clear that they would adopt pro-bourse policies and this is what counts."

The Athens general share index closed 0.63 percent, or 5.86 points lower at 927.36 from Friday's 933.22 close after opening at 931.47 points. Turnover eased to 5.37 billion drachmas on volume of 3.21 million shares.

Two polls by private polling companies MRB and PRC showed that the conservative New Democracy party and socialist PASOK were neck-and-neck going into the final stretch with small parties on the Left recording gains.
The MRB poll put the conservatives ahead with 31 percent to the socialists' 30.6 percent but the PRC poll placed the socialists in front with 32.8 percent to 31.9 percent for the conservatives.
Greece will hold early elections September 22.
There were a few block trades with 100,000 shares of Alte changing hands at 3,400 drachmas, 200,000 shares of Mills St.George at 1,800 drachmas and 55,000 shares of Papastratos at 5,975 drachmas.

Advancers traced decliners 60 to 143 with 27 issues unchanged on 230 traded. Banks closed down 0.43 percent, industrials retreated 0.89 percent with construction losing 1.36 percent. Small-caps slipped 0.10 percent.

The Merrill Lynch call spread warrant on OTE with a strike price of 3,800 drachmas was quoted at 556-574 at the close. Shares of OTE telecom, the underlying, ended down five drachmas at 4,020 in light trade.

The recently launched Merrill Lynch stock index call warrant based on a basket of 23 shares was quoted lower at 193.70-203.90 drachmas. It expires on January 9 1998 with a strike price of 1000. It was in the money at 1016.6.
The Morgan Stanley Hellenic Blue Chip Warrant, which has a strike price of 100 marks, was quoted at 3,518-3,746 drachmas at the close. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
